scope: Useful lexical-entry links and preparation classification for the integrated course; complete later-band dictionary coverage is not established.
thresholdPolicy: Unchanged historical floors apply to preparation that actually names a dictionary lexical entry. Raw coverage remains visible. Explicit names cannot credit homographs; individually declared compositional constructions have a separate count, while existing dictionary expressions remain eligible.

dictionary.rawAndActiveResolutionParity: passed all released lesson preparations in test-course-words

contextualSenseLinks.rationale: The opening preparation contrasts every day with one occasion. The separate board teaches la volta as a countable time/occasion, rather than translating bare volta as once.
The lesson reports instructions from the person in charge. The supplied role is a boss, rather than a body part or an item of clothing.
